subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should external messaging-channel source replies default to explicit message-tool/final-only delivery instead of automatic bare assistant text delivery?
rationale: The code evidence shows a real security and channel-delivery bug, but the durable fix changes long-standing automatic reply semantics for existing channel setups.

options.title: Make explicit delivery the default
options.body: Switch external channel/source sessions to final-only or message-tool-only delivery, add upgrade guidance or migration handling, and keep automatic bare text only where explicitly configured.

options.title: Keep automatic default with opt-in hardening
options.body: Preserve current automatic bare-text behavior and add a user-visible opt-in setting for stricter final-tag or message-tool-only delivery.

options.title: Patch only known leak variants
options.body: Land targeted suppressions for commentary, NO_REPLY, and cron variants while accepting that ordinary unphased automatic text can remain deliverable.

recommendation.title: Make explicit delivery the default
recommendation.body: Switch external channel/source sessions to final-only or message-tool-only delivery, add upgrade guidance or migration handling, and keep automatic bare text only where explicitly configured.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history connects this owner most directly to the central source-reply, payload, and cron surfaces that would need the policy implementation.
